title: Battle of Sig
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sig", at revision 1370274369, opens: "In the Battle of Sig, French forces, assisted by the Douair and Smela tribes, fought the Algerian resistance led by Emir Abdelkader in the forest of Moulay-Ismaël near Sig." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889985, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1835 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
